description: What kinds of thing this document holds — every format declared in it, with its columns, their types, units, bounds and enum members, and the prose the author wrote around them. The columns are declared per document: `start_here` ends with one line per format, enough to write a row, and this is the whole declaration. Name a `format` for its full column list; omit it for the list of what is declared. Reads the file; never modifies it.

format.description: One declared format by name, for its full column list.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
